description: Functions with a compliance theorem. A function with an interface is a black box to every caller: callers import only its generated interface (tools/block/render_interfaces.py renders ZesuSsz/Interfaces/<F>.v and <F>Correct.v from this file), whose call-spec predicates are sealed by module ascription. tools/block/check_proved_functions.py (check-fast) enforces the imports, the generator's call specs, theorem coverage and interface freshness; check_proof_hygiene.py refuses unfolding a sealed name outside its interface.
